implementation: pure NumPy statistics adapter; standard library only for binding hashes and selftest receipt
checks_implemented: D2 paired relative PSD MAE 95% CI upper < 0
D3 candidate minus REAL+original SIM absolute PSD MAE 95% CI upper < 0
D4 full REAL PSD MAE point noninferiority <= +5%
D5 REAL1024 logQ RMSE point noninferiority <= +5%
D6 every D1-D5 passes for Ridge and HGB and explicit frozen design validity

bootstrap.resampling: one shared whole-group draw per replicate across all 8 prediction packets
bootstrap.relative_CI: ratio computed after each replicate's two weighted MAEs
bootstrap.invalid_replicates: no discard; any invalid replicate makes that CI undefined and not passing

interface_contract.omitted_declaration: signature raises TypeError; evaluation cannot run or pass
interface_contract.false_or_nonbool_declaration: all checks undefined and not passing
interface_contract.packet_bindings: truth and every arm separately supply same-order row_ids and group_ids
interface_contract.missing_zero_nonfinite: undefined and not passing; no denominator floor
